questions.group: A. The face of the plate
questions.question: Which absolute physical face of the plate faced the Polytec in the 261016 series: the face with the marking or the face without it?
questions.acceptable_evidence: one answer (marked / unmarked) with its source; the owner's same-face statement then carries it to 261027. 'The same face as in 261016' is relative and does not answer it

questions.group: A. The face of the plate
questions.question: Which source document or confirmation establishes that face (for example a photograph of the mounted plate from the Polytec side with the marking visible, a laboratory record, the owner's own observation)?
questions.acceptable_evidence: the document is chosen in Source Audit; it is recorded by SHA-256 and its reading is confirmed by the owner

questions.question: Which of these existing materials is available: (a) the original 300by300_plate_only_1mm_ROTATED_261027.svd; (b) a PSV screenshot of 261016 with the points on the video frame; (c) the original scanner angles and the camera frame / scale; (d) other independently measured coordinates of the points?
questions.acceptable_evidence: any one of (a)–(d); if none is available, both facts stay NOT_VERIFIED (the 277.7 × 277.0 mm UNV grid and the diagnostic 261016 reconstruction are never the physical window)

questions.question: Is there a measured physical landmark that ties FE (0, 0) to a specific corner of the plate?
questions.acceptable_evidence: a measured landmark recorded with its source

questions.question: If there is none: should a geometrically founded FE variant with a measured asymmetry (for example the measured edge thicknesses) be prepared? Naming a corner by agreement alone stays CONVENTION_ONLY and is never physical evidence.
questions.acceptable_evidence: an owner decision to prepare such a variant (its FE runs need their own authorisation)

questions.group: D. The applicability of the model

questions.acceptable_evidence: a measurement or record with its source; never derived from a measured or FE frequency
